items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: You'd hear a colored boy named Slim upstairs... I'd say yeah, he's all right.

ctx.x: You'd hear a colored boy named Slim upstairs and that's when the Revenue men were breaking down the doors, you know, because we was selling whiskey. We sold everybody, but couldn't nobody get to drink in my club unless

I give the okay, because we had a boss named Leo Bernstein, he'd come over and say, anybody want a drink. He'd say to me, you know that guy, and I'd say yeah, he's all right. Never got busted. I had a good memory. I could remember all that time, we had six hostesses, you know, just sit around with the stags.. Of course, they gig afterwards. (Laughter)
